pixel_findings.category: source identity, proportions and floor hierarchy
pixel_findings.observations: The exact duplex reads as two homes with two visible above-grade storeys, taller upper outer glazing, paired central cedar entry recesses/slits, independent stairs, a dark centre divider and a slightly advanced right front half. Restored low glazing bands now continue the photographed base cadence. Source pixels correctly govern the prose conflict about three storeys and stucco. Absolute dimensions remain conceptual.

pixel_findings.category: footprint, roof graph and complete envelope
pixel_findings.observations: Two continuous flat decks, raised centre division, stepped outer edges above the cedar side extensions and three small penetrations agree with the locked topology. Front, both sides, rear and rear-side show a complete building. The roof-contact and rear-side images now show solid support beneath the centre coping without the v003 daylight slot. No new roof, wall or cap discontinuity is visible.

pixel_findings.category: openings, returns, optical layers and occupied depth
pixel_findings.observations: Main front windows, cedar entry slits, both side orientations, cedar projections and rear openings retain recessed frames, sills and physical wall-section depth. The two restored base openings show two separate optical panes, a centre mullion and recessed dark depth. They sit below the ground-floor slab and above the plinth. Large front windows show curtain strips separated from the pane and faint furniture/room depth; rear glazing reads into enclosed space. The restrained semantic-clay optics are not a photoreal glazing claim.

pixel_findings.category: stairs, walks, landings, canopies, foundation and slab contact
pixel_findings.observations: Front stair/walk pairs and canopies remain separate, with connected threshold landings and no duplicated floor shelf inside the cedar recess. Stair blocks touch their walk/grade and landing surfaces; rail posts meet the stair bodies. The continuous brick carriers do not expose the former occupied-slab/foundation stripe. The plinth remains below the brick base, and the new glazing does not displace it. Inferred rear stairs and rails remain grounded and connected.

pixel_findings.category: side projections, floors and residential program
pixel_findings.observations: Both cedar upper bays have enclosed side/end returns, seated occupied-floor edges and recessed small openings. Two independent homes, entries and modest residential room depth remain legible. Read-only geometry review preserves independent internal stair runs with upper-slab endpoints. Rear windows/rooms, left-side opening details and hidden circulation are inferred. The shallow enclosure behind the new base bands does not claim a modeled full basement; below-grade rooms and excavations are expressly excluded.

Geometric facade bays, courses, timber joints, window cadence and roof form carry identity. Wall/timber/metal/concrete/glass zones continue around the envelope. The actual GLB contains no images or textures. PBR morphology, photographic ageing, exact source reflections and textured identity derivatives remain outside this bounded clay profile.

All 13 mandatory native renders were individually opened afresh. Every whole-building role includes grade, the complete building/step footprint and highest termination with visible neutral margin. The low front-corner and aerial roles separately compare to the street and oblique sources; the true top view resolves roof topology. Close views expose their named opening/contact relationships without an obstructing addition. The repaired roof section is clearly visible in roof_contact and rear_side.

The exact locked source board and both native 1080x1920 phone boards were opened. The phone source comparison retains twin-home hierarchy, stepped footprint, roof division and restored base openings. The construction board shows the stair/landing separation, opening depth, seated centre roof coping and side extensions. Labels correctly identify v004 and declare clay/inferred-view limitations.

Neighbouring houses, garages, street, planting and mature contextual trees remain excluded from this individual building asset. Their exclusion does not create a terrain, landscape, site design or surveyed-model approval.

All original source and local copy hashes agree. Script and board-input hashes agree with the inspected files. Build, delivery, builder and independently computed GLB hashes match. The documented renderer removes authored meshes, reimports the exact exported GLB and applies no post-export material replacement. Deterministic checks support, but do not replace, this fresh complete pixel review. The builder remains a separate role; no keeper or runtime promotion is performed.

regression_checks.basis: Separate canopies/stairs/walks and touching non-overlapping tread/landing top ownership remain visible in architecture_close and aerial.
No duplicate upper floor shelf in the entry recess; canopy, threshold, first/last riser and floor relationships remain coherent.
Full front/side/rear elevations remain free of coplanar floor-material or full-height foundation stripes across the brick carrier.
Street-height front_corner retained; aerial/top/roof_contact retain three unambiguous pipe fittings, one left and two right.

Two low source-visible glazing bands are restored under the living windows. front, front_corner and architecture_close show actual recesses, sills and two panes; the old continuous brick strip is gone. New openings span z=.30-.70 m, below the slab underside .74 m and above the plinth .18 m. Below-grade program remains excluded rather than asserted.

roof_contact and rear_side show an uninterrupted wall/upstand beneath the centre cap, with no continuous daylight slot. Delivered GLB positions put the wall top at8.86 m and cap underside at8.84 m, confirming20 mm positive overlap.

supporting_geometry_observation.verification: Read-only GLB POSITION accessor decoding plus construction schedule; each asserted visible relationship independently confirmed in native render pixels.

limitations: Rear fenestration and internal partitions are inferred consistently from two separate homes; not claimed as photographed.
Left upper side projection repeats the stepped outline visible in top view; its windows are inferred.
Two separate residential circulation routes and modest furniture are inferred behind visible glazing.
Only the above-grade basement glazing bands are visible; below-grade rooms and excavations are outside this asset. The bands open into the enclosed shallow volume below the ground-floor slab.
Neighbouring buildings, alley garages, public street and mature contextual trees are excluded from this building asset.
Conceptual dimensions are inferred from source references, not survey.
This full review covers architectural clay only; source-conditioned PBR and photoreal finishes are omitted by design.
Native fixed scale only; no terrain fit, resizing, sibling substitution or repetition contract is approved.
